Completed all five declared pyramid/cross-cohort derivative attempts with frozen source d7b5a3137d9402ea6b95eca75f384cc397b8e07d448b83d8d92442b8ed9fe429. All 210 measurements retained; all captured objective values equal exactly, and all 42 fine-control measurements reproduce exactly. Spatial source/composition chain passes 15/15 additional-step directions (12/12 at four newly inspected states), but only 13/15 original-step directions (11/12 new). New OASIS11 coarse-end smooth-wave failure: best original error 0.787886% exceeds unchanged 0.5%; smaller-step minimum 0.280941%. Original OASIS13 fine-end translation failure remains 3.589115%. CC intensity chain passes 15/15 in both ranges; production passes 1/15 original and 0/15 additional. All ten arms have full derivative support and zero source knots. Negative production gradient remains descent at every state at the smallest perturbation. Several coarse spatial curves fluctuate or plateau; passing the declared criterion does not establish an exact derivative throughout optimization or prove cell crossings as the cause. No optimizer change or anatomical-improvement claim.

Archived full ledger, independently recomputed verdicts, source/input/engine/declaration checks and visually reviewed 15-panel plot at docs/benchmarks/evidence/halfflow-pyramid-chain-20261014/outcomes-v1. Report docs/benchmarks/halfflow-pyramid-chain-v1.md. Nine JVM, nine Scala.js and two runner tests from preparation pass, initial fixture failure retained. D01/D02 remain open: complete anatomical trajectories, image-order/mixed acquired grids/boundary/regularization checks and controlled anatomy experiment remain. Evidence stays local pending the existing publication authorization request.
